plan: 77.44.6.1.C — desktop dock drag lifecycle and stale-layout cancellation
scope: Cancel active desktop dock dragging whenever responsive mode or another editor tab changes the layout, ignore late drops, and keep Escape from collapsing the workspace while it cancels a drag.

behavior: The dock reorder lifecycle now exposes its cancellation callback to the shell and clears target styling and drag state when the viewport crosses into the mobile drawer breakpoint.
A storage event for shell dock state or appearance/profile state cancels any geometry-dependent drag before the received state is painted.
Escape cancels a live dock drag without allowing the global Escape handler to collapse the page tools dock and Inspector; a late drop cannot reorder or persist anything after cancellation.
The updated workspace-appearance module has an explicit cache version in the shell import, and the shell entry URL is also versioned.
implementation.reuse_decision: Existing shell DragEvent lifecycle, responsive matchMedia listener, same-origin Storage API, and workspace preference adapter were sufficient; no new dock engine or dependency was justified for cancellation semantics.
